name: altimateguide-agent-mcp
description: Submit a software tool to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review.
long_description:
Lets an AI agent submit a software tool (name, URL, description, categories, features, pros/cons, pricing) to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review. The listing is queued as pending — nothing is published automatically.

Tools: start_login / complete_login (email OTP → token), list_categories, check_duplicate, submit_tool, get_submission, upgrade_listing (sayabout / badge / paid). Supply an account API token (from https://altimateguide.com/account), or mint one at runtime with complete_login.

agent_token.title: Altimateguide API token
agent_token.description: Optional. Create one at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access), or mint one at runtime with the complete_login tool.
